scope.flow: Launchpad stake/unstake (via LaunchToken transfer fee shares) triggering Distributor reward distribution
scope.environment: GTE perps launchpad contracts (Distributor, Launchpad, LaunchToken)
evidence: Buy/sell launch tokens leads ==> rewards are paid to `Launchpad` (msg.sender) instead of the user
- `Distributor._distributeAssets` sends realized rewards to `msg.sender`. In stake/unstake flows, `msg.sender` is `Launchpad`, not the user.
- `Launchpad` has no ERC20 forwarding or rescue; rewards accumulate on `Launchpad` and users don’t receive them. Accounting reduces `totalPendingRewards`, so value is effectively locked.
- Users can trigger this by causing any update (stake/unstake vis buy/sell) to realize pending; the PoC confirms both paths.
- Payout: `Distributor._distributeAssets` → `quoteToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, R)` where `msg.sender == Launchpad`
- In `Distributor`, change distribution recipient to the actual `account` on stake/unstake:
- Pass `account` to `increaseStake`/`decreaseStake` internals and use it in `_distributeAssets` instead of `msg.sender`.

entities.name: user (staker)
evidence: Buy/sell launch tokens leads ==> rewards are paid to `Launchpad` (msg.sender) instead of the user
- `LaunchToken.transfer(userA, S)` → `LaunchToken._increaseFeeShares` → `Launchpad.increaseStake(userA, S)` → `Distributor.increaseStake(baseToken, userA, S)`
- `LaunchToken.transfer(userA, δ)` → `Launchpad.increaseStake(userA, δ)` → `Distributor.increaseStake(baseToken, userA, δ)`
- `LaunchToken.transfer(launchpad, δ)` → `Launchpad.decreaseStake(userA, δ)` → `Distributor.decreaseStake(baseToken, userA, δ)`

evidence: - `Distributor._distributeAssets` sends realized rewards to `msg.sender`. In stake/unstake flows, `msg.sender` is `Launchpad`, not the user.

- Payout: `Distributor._distributeAssets` → `quoteToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, R)` where `msg.sender == Launchpad`
- No ERC20 forward/rescue on `Launchpad` → rewards stuck on `Launchpad`

evidence: - `Distributor.addRewards(baseToken, quoteToken, 0, R)`

- User gets 0; `Launchpad` balance of `quoteToken` increases by `R`

statements.text: A stake exists for the user (totalShares = S, userA.shares = S) before the triggering update.
evidence: - Setup (stake exists)
- State: `totalShares = S`, `userA.shares = S`

statements.text: Rewards R are added to the Distributor (pendingQuoteRewards += R, totalPendingRewards[quoteToken] += R) before the triggering update.
evidence: - Add rewards
- `Distributor.addRewards(baseToken, quoteToken, 0, R)`
- State: `pendingQuoteRewards += R`, `totalPendingRewards[quoteToken] += R`

statements.text: A stake or unstake update is triggered via LaunchToken transfer, calling Launchpad.increaseStake/decreaseStake and Distributor.increaseStake/decreaseStake.
evidence: - Users can trigger this by causing any update (stake/unstake vis buy/sell) to realize pending; the PoC confirms both paths.
- Trigger via stake (pays Launchpad)
- `LaunchToken.transfer(userA, δ)` → `Launchpad.increaseStake(userA, δ)` → `Distributor.increaseStake(baseToken, userA, δ)`
- Trigger via unstake (also pays Launchpad)
- `LaunchToken.transfer(launchpad, δ)` → `Launchpad.decreaseStake(userA, δ)` → `Distributor.decreaseStake(baseToken, userA, δ)`

statements.text: Distributor._distributeAssets sends realized rewards to msg.sender, which in stake/unstake flows is Launchpad rather than the user account.

- Payout: `Distributor._distributeAssets` → `quoteToken.safeTransfer(msg.sender, R)` where `msg.sender == Launchpad`

statements.text: Launchpad has no ERC20 forwarding or rescue mechanism, so rewards transferred to it are not passed on to the user.
evidence: - `Launchpad` has no ERC20 forwarding or rescue; rewards accumulate on `Launchpad` and users don’t receive them. Accounting reduces `totalPendingRewards`, so value is effectively locked.
- No ERC20 forward/rescue on `Launchpad` → rewards stuck on `Launchpad`
- Or, have `Launchpad` capture returned amounts and immediately forward ERC20s to `account`
